G2736.definition: adv. (κατά),  ; 1. down, downwards (with verbs of motion), Mat.4:6, Luk.4:9, Jhn.8:6, 8, Act.20:9. ; 2. below, beneath: Mrk.14:66, Act.2:19" (LXX) ; ἕως κ. (Eze.1:27, al.), Mat.27:51, Mrk.15:38. τὰ κ. (opposite to τ. ἄνω), Jhn.8:23. Compar. κατωτέρω: ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κ. (cf. 1Ch.27:21), Mat.2:16.†; (AS)

G2799.definition: of any loud expression of pain or sorrow, esp. for the dead, to weep, lament; (a) intrans.: Mrk.5:38-39 14:72 (M, Pr., 131) Mrk.16:10, Luk.7:13, 32 7:38 8:52, Jhn.11:31, 33 16:20 20:11, 13 20:15 Act.9:39 21:13, 1Co.7:30, Php.3:18, Jas.4:9 5:1, Rev.5:5 18:15, 19; πολύ, Rev.5:4; πολλά, Act.8:24 (WH, mg.); πικρῶς, Mat.26:75, Luk.22:62; opposite to γελάω, Luk.6:21, 25; χαίρω, Rom.12:15; before ἐπί, with accusative…

G2730.definition: κατ-οικέω, -ῶ; 1. trans., to inhabit, dwell in: with accusative, Luk.13:4, Act.1:10 2:9, 14 4:16 9:32, 35 19:10, 17. Rev.17:2; of God, Mat.23:21. ; 2. Intrans., to settle, dwell: Act.22:12; before ἐν (cl.), Act.1:20 (LXX) Act.2:5 7:2, 4 7:48 9:22 11:29 13:27 17:24, Heb.11:9, Rev.13:12; before εἰς (B1., § 39, 3; M, Pr., 62 f., 234 f.), Mat.2:23 4:13, Act.7:4; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς (Num.13:33, al.), Rev.3:10 6:10 8:13 11:10…

G2784.definition: to be a herald, to proclaim: Mrk.1:45 7:36, Luk.4:18-19" (LXX) (but see Field, Notes, 174) Luk.8:39, Rom.2:21, 1Co.9:27, Gal.5:11, al.; in NT, chiefly of the proclamation of the Gospel, to proclaim, preach: τὸ εὐαγέλιον, Mat.4:23 9:35 24:14 26:13, Mrk.1:14 13:10 14:9 16:15, Gal.2:2, Col.1:23, 1Th.2:9; before εἰς, Mrk.1:39 13:10, Luk.4:44, 1Th.2:9; ἵνα, Mrk.6:12; with inf.. Rom.2:21; κ. Χριστόν, Ἰησοῦν, Act.8:5 9:20…
renderings: so that after I have preached

G2749.definition: used as passive of τίθημι (LS, see word), to be laid, to lie; (a) of persons: an infant, Luk.2:12, 16; a dead body, Mat.28:6, Luk.23:53, Jhn.20:12; (b) of things, to lie, be laid or set, stand: Mat.5:14, Jhn.2:6 19:29 20:5-7 21:9, Rev.4:2 21:16; trop., Θεμέλιος, 1Co.3:11; before prep. with accusative, πρός, Mat.3:10, Luk.3:9; εἰς, Luk.12:19; ἐπί, trop., κάλυμμα, 2Co.3:15. Metaphorical, ὁ κόσμος ἐν τ. πονηριῷ κ.…

G2762.definition: (κέρας), ; a little horn: of the point or extremity which distinguishes some Heb. letters from others (e.g. ד from ר; DCG, ii, 733), Mat.5:18, Luk.16:17.†; (AS)

G2776.definition: the head: Mat.5:35, Mrk.6:24, Rev.1:14 9:7, al. mult.; figuratively, ἄνθρακες ἐπὶ τὴν κ., Rom.12:20 (LXX); αἷμι, Act.18:6; metaphorically, of a husband, with genitive, 1Co.1:13, Eph.5:23; of Christ, 1Co.11:3, Eph.4:15 5:23, Col.1:18 2:10, 19; of things, κ. γωνίας, Mat.21:42 (LXX) ; (AS)

G2706.definition: κατα-φρονέω, -ῶ; to think little of, despise: with genitive, Mat.6:24 18:10, Luk.16:13, Rom.2:4, 1Co.11:22, 1Ti.4:12 6:2, Heb.12:2, 2Pe.2:10.†; (AS)

G2753.definition: to urge on, bid by word of mouth, order, command (mostly of one in authority): with accusative and inf. aor., Mat.14:19, 28 18:25 27:64, Luk.18:40, Act.4:15 5:34 8:38 22:30 23:10 25:6, 17; with ellipse of accusative, Mat.8:18 14:9 27:58, Act.12:19 21:33; with accusative and inf. Pres., Act.21:34 22:24 23:3, 35 25:21 27:43; with ellipse of accusative, Act.16:22; ptcp. aor., Act.25:23.†; SYN.: see: ἐντέλλω (AS)

G2723.definition: (κατά, ἀγορεύω),  ; to make accusation, accuse, ; (a) in general: absol., Rom.2:15; with genitive of person(s) (cl., WM, 254), Jhn.5:45; irreg. with accusative of person(s), Rev.12:10; (b) before a judge: absol., Act.24:2, 19; with genitive of person(s), Mat.12:10, Mrk.3:2, Luk.6:7 11:54 (WH, txt., R, om.), Luk.23:2, 10, Jhn.8:6 Act.25:5 28:19; id. with accusative of thing(s) (cl., but see WM, l.with), Mrk.15:3-4…

G2782.definition: (κηρύσσω),  ; in cl., ; that which is cried by a herald, a proclamation. In NT (see Lft., Notes, 161), of God's heralds, proclamation, message, preaching (i.e. the substance as distinct from the act which would be expressed by † κήρυξις): Mat.12:41, Luk.11:32, 1Co.1:21, 2Ti.4:17, Tit.1:3; with genitive cubic., τὸ κ. μου, 1Co.2:4; ἡμῶν, 1Co.15:14; with genitive obj., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Rom.16:25.†; (AS)

G2719.definition: κατ-εσθίω; ("perfective" comp. of ἐσθίω, which see, and cf. M, Pr., 111)  ; to eat up, devour: with accusative, of seed, Mat.13:4, Mrk.4:4, Luk.8:5; τέκνον, Rev.12:4; βιβλαρίδιον, Rev.10:9-10; metaphorically, οἰκίας, Mat.23:13, Mrk.12:40, Luk.20:47; τ. βίον, Luk.15:30; with accusative of person(s), Jhn.2:17 (LXX), 2Co.11:20, Gal.5:15, Rev.11:5 20:9.†; (AS)

G2739.definition: (καῦμα), ; to burn or scorch up: with accusative before ἐν πυρί, Rev.16:8. Pass., Mat.13:14, Mrk.4:6; before καῦμα μέγα, Rev.16:9.†; (AS)

G2798.definition: (κλάω),  ; a young tender shoot broken off for grafting; then, a branch: Mat.13:32 21:8 24:32, Mrk.4:32 13:28, Luk.13:19; metaphorically, of descendants (cf. Sir.40:15), Rom.11:16-19, 21.†; (AS)

G2729.definition: κατ-ισχύω; to overpower, prevail against, prevail: absol., Luk.23:23; with inf., Luk.21:36; with genitive, Mat.16:18.†; (AS)

G2770.definition: to gain: with accusative, Mat.25:16-17, 20 25:22; τ. κόσμον, Mat.16:26, Mrk.8:36, Luk.9:25; absol., to make profit, get gain: Jas.4:13. Metaphorical, with accusative of thing(s), to save oneself from, avoid: Act.27:21 (Field, Notes, 145); with accusative of person(s), to gain, win: Mat.18:15, 1Co.9:19-22, Php.3:8; pass., 1Pe.3:1.†; (AS)

G2778.definition: a poll-tax: Mat.17:25 22:17, Mrk.12:14 (WH, mg., ἐπικεφάλαιον); τ. νόμισμα τοῦ κ., Mat.22:19 (see MM, Exp., xv).†; (AS)

G2742.definition: (καίω),  ; 1. burning heat (Ge, Isa (?), Jth, ll.with, Sir.18:16): Mat.20:12, Luk.12:55 (Jas.1:11, AV). ; 2. a hot wind from the east (Heb. קָדִים, see LXX, ll.with), the modern sirocco (see CGT on Amo.4:9): Jas.1:11 (RV, the scorching wind; cf. R, mg., the hot wind, Mt, Lk, ll.with).†; (AS)

G2715.definition: κατ-εξουσιάζω ; to exercise authority over: with genitive of person(s), Mat.20:25, Mrk.10:42.†; SYN: (κατακυριεύω) (see Swete, Mk., l.with) ; (AS)

G2713.definition: adv.,  ; over against, opposite, before: ἡ, κ. κώμη, Luk.19:30; as prep., with genitive, Mat.21:2 27:24 (ἀπ-, WH, mg.), Mrk.11:2 12:41 (ἀπ-, WH, mg.) Mrk.13:3; metaphorically, before, before θεοῦ, Rom.4:17, 2Co.2:17 12:19.†; (AS)

G2795.definition: 1. to set in motion, move: Mat.23:4; τ. κεφαλήν (Psa.22:8, al.), Mat.27:39, Mrk.15:29; pass. (cf. Gen.7:21), Act.17:28. ; 2. to remove: Rev.2:5 6:14. ; 3. to excite, stir up: Act.24:5; pass., Act.21:30 (cf. μετα-, συν-κινέω).†; (AS)

G2787.definition: a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, Mat.24:38, Luk.17:27, Heb.11:7, 1Pe.3:20; of the ark of the covenant, Heb.9:4, Rev.11:19.†; (AS)

G2708.definition: κατα-χέω; to pour down upon: with genitive (cl.), Mrk.14:3; before ἐπί, with genitive, Mat.26:7.†; (AS)

G2705.definition: κατα-φιλέω, -ῶ; to kiss fervently, kiss affectionately: Mat.26:49, Mrk.14:45, Luk.7:38, 45 15:20, Act.20:37.†; (AS)

G2763.definition: (κεράννυμι),  ; a potter: Rom.9:21; ὁ ἀγρὸς τοῦ κ., Mat.27:7, (LXX).†; (AS)

G2756.definition: empty (Gen.37:24, Jdg.7:16). Metaphorical, ; (a) empty, vain: λόγοι, Eph.5:6; ἀπάτη, Col.2:8; κήρυγμα, πίστις, 1Co.15:14; (b) vain, fruitless: ἡ χάρις, 1Co.15:10; κόπος, 1Co.15:50; ἡ εἴσοδος, 1Th.2:1; κενά, Act.4:25 (LXX); εἰς κενόν, in vain, to no purpose (Diod., LXX; cl. διὰ κενῆς), 2Co.6:1, Gal.2:2, Php.2:16, 1Th.3:5; (with) of persons, empty-handed: Mrk.12:3, Luk.1:53 20:10-11; vain, Jas.2:20.†; SYN.: μάταιος…

G2775.definition: κεφαλιόω (Rec. -αιόω, ), -ῶ ; (κεφάλιον, dimin. of κεφαλή, in late writers) ; 1. (-αιόω) to sum up (Thuc., al.). ; 2. (In NT, only) to wound on the head: Mrk.12:4.†; (AS)

G2765.definition: (κέραμος),  ; an earthen vessel, a jar or jug: ὕδατος, Mrk.14:13, Luk.22:10.†; (AS)

G2760.definition: a centurion: Mrk.15:39, 44-45 (Mt, Lk, use ἑκιτόνταρχος (-ης), q.v).†; (AS)

G2727.definition: κατ-ηχέω, -ῶ ; 1. to resound. ; 2. to teach by word of mouth, instruct, inform (see 131., Phil. Gosp., 20, 31): Gal.6:6; with accusative of person(s), 1Co.14:19; pass. with accusative of thing(s), Luk.1:4 (ICC, in l), Act.18:25 21:24 (cf. Lk, l.with), Gal.6:6; before κ, with genitive of thing(s), Rom.2:18; περί, with genitive of person(s), Act.21:21.†; (AS)

G2768.definition: (pl. not irreg. as in Attic), τό,  ; a horn: Rev.5:6 12:3 13:1, 11 17:3, 7 17:12, 16; of the projections at the corners of the altar (Exo.29:12, al.): Rev.9:13. Metaphorical, as symbol of strength, κ. σωτηρίας (cf. Psa.18:3, al.): Luk.1:69.†; (AS)

G2720.definition: κατ-ευθύνω; to make or keep straight, direct, guide: metaphorically, τ. ὁδόν, 1Th.3:11; τ. πόδας εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης, Luk.1:79; τ. καρδίας εἰς τ. ἀγάπην, 2Th.3:5.†; (AS)

G2718.definition: κατ-έρχομαι; to come down, go down: before εἰς, Luk.4:31, Act.8:5 13:4 15:30 19:1, Τ; ἀπό, Luk.9:37, Act.15:1 18:5 21:10; ἀπό and εἰς, Act.11:27 12:10; of coming to port by ship, Act.18:22 21:3 27:5; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Act.9:32; metaphorically, of gifts from God, Jas.3:15.†; (AS)

G2722.definition: κατ-έχω; 1. perfective of ἔχω (M, Pr., 116; M, Th., 155), ; (a) to possess, hold fast: Luk.8:15, Jhn.5:4, Rom.1:18 (Lft., Notes, 251), 1Co.7:30 11:2, 2Co.6:10, 1Th.5:21, Heb.3:6, 14 10:23; (b) to lay hold of, get possession of: Luk.14:9. ; 2. to hold back, detain, restrain (M, Th., 156 f.): with accusative before τοῦ μή with inf., Luk.4:42; before πρός, with accusative, Phm 13; absol., τὸ κατέχον (ὁ κ.), 2Th.2:6-7.…

G2766.definition: κεραμος, -ου, ὁ; (κεράννυμι),  ; 1. potter's clay. ; 2. an earthen vessel. ; 3. a tile: Luk.5:19.†; (AS)

G2793.definition: (κίνδυνος),  ; 1. to be daring, to venture. ; 2. to be in danger: Luk.8:23, Act.19:27, 40, 1Co.15:30.†; (AS)

G2769.definition: (dimin. of κέρας), ; 1. a little horn (Arist.). ; 2. In pl. (the fruit of the κερατέα), carob-pods: Luk.15:16.†; (AS)

G2711.definition: κατα-ψύχω; to cool: with accusative, Luk.16:24.†; (AS)

G2773.definition: κερματιατής, -οῦ, ὁ; (κερματίζω, to cut small, coin into small money), ; a money changer: Jhn.2:14.†; (AS)

G2772.definition: (κείρω), ; 1. a slice, hence, ; 2. a small coin: pl., Jhn.2:15.†; (AS)

G2725.definition: an accuser: Act.23:30, 35 24:8 (WH, R, txt. om.) Act.25:16, 18.†; (AS)

G2750.definition: a vernacular word, ; 1 1, a bed-cord (Aristoph., AV., 816; Pr, l.with). ; 2. In pl., swathings (cf. Field, Notes, 96 f.): Jhn.11:44.†; (AS)

G2748.definition: a cedar: χείμαρρος τῶν Κ. (as in 2Sam, 1Ki, ll. with), Jhn.18:1 (Rec. Tr., WH, R, mg.; τοῦ Κέδρου, T, WH, mg., see: Κεδρών, and cf. Westc., in l; WH, App., 89 f.; Abbott, JG, 513 ff).†; Κεδρών ; (see: κέδρος), ὁ, ; indecl. ; (in FlJ, genitive -ῶνος; Heb. קִדְרוֹן),  ; Cedron (OT, Kidron): χείμαρρος τοῦ Κ., Jhn.18:1 (L, Tr., mg., R, txt.; cf. Bl., 10, 5; Lft., Essays, 172 ff).†; (AS)

G2724.definition: (κατήγορος), ; an accusation, charge: with genitive of person(s), Jhn.18:29; before κατά, with id., 1Ti.5:19; with genitive of thing(s), Tit.1:6.†; (AS)

G2780.definition: κηπ-ουρός, -οῦ, ὁ; (κῆπος + οὖρος, a watcher) ; a gardener: Jhn.20:15.†; (AS)

G2791.definition: Κιλικία, -ας, ἡ ; Cilicia, a province of Asia Minor: Act.6:9 15:23, 41 21:39 22:3 23:34 27:5, Gal.1:21.†; (AS)

G2751.definition: to cut short the hair, shear: a sheep, Act.8:32 (Isa, l.with). Mid., to have one's hair cut off, be shorn: absol., 1Co.11:6; τ-. κεφαλήν, Act.18:18.†; (AS)

G2703.definition: κατα-φεύγω; to flee for refuge: before εἰς, Act.14:6; metaphorically, with inf., Heb.6:18.†; (AS)

G2733.definition: κατ-οικία, -ας, ἡ; (κατοικέω),  ; 1. a dwelling: Act.17:26. ; 2. a settlement (Polyb.).†; (AS)

G2721.definition: κατ-εφ-ίστημι ; to rise up against: Act.18:12.†; (AS)

G2747.definition: Κενχρεαί (Rec. Κεχγ-; ν. WH, App., 150), -ῶν, αἱ, ; Cenchreæ, a port of Corinth: Act.18:18, Rom.16:1.†; (AS)

G2702.definition: κατα-φέρω; to bring down: αἰτιώματα, Act.25:7; ψῆφον, to cast a ballot, Act.26:10; pass., to be borne down: ὕπνῳ, ἀπὸ τ. ὕ., Act.20:9.†; (AS)

G2701.definition: κατα-τρέχω; to run down: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Act.21:32.†; (AS)

G2774.definition: (κεφαλή),  ; of the head; metaphorically, principal, chief; mostly as subst., κεφάλαιον, τό; ; 1. the chief point: Heb.8:1. ; 2. the sum total, amount: Act.22:28 (other meaning, LS, see word).†; (AS)

G2759.definition: (εκντέω, to prick),  ; 1. a sting (4Mac, l.with): Rev.9:10. Metaphorical (as Hos.13:14): τ. θανάτου, 1Co.15:55 (LXX), 1Co.15:56, ; 2. a goad: pl., Act.26:14.†; (AS)

G2716.definition: κατ-εργάζομαι; (emphatic form of ἐργάζομαι),  ; to effect by labour, achieve, work out, bring about: with accusative, Rom.4:15 5:3 7:8, 15-20, 2Co.7:10, Eph.6:13, Jas.1:3; pass., 2Co.12:12; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Rom.7:13, 2Co.4:17 7:11 9:11; id. before διά, with genitive of person(s), Rom.15:18; τ. σωτηρίαν, Php.2:12; with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, 2Co.5:5 (RV, wrought); of…

G2744.definition: to boast or glory (in LXX, of joyous exultation, and so in the NT quotations, infr.; cf. DB, ii, 790b; Hort on Jas.1:9): absol., 1Co.1:31 (LXX) 1Co.4:7 13:3, 2Co.10:13 10:17" (LXX) 2Co.11:16 11:18 12:1 12:6, Eph.2:9, Jas.4:16; with accusative of thing(s), 2Co.9:2 11:30; before ἐν (LXX), Rom.2:23 5:3, 1Co.3:21, 2Co.5:12 10:15 11:12 12:5 12:9, Gal.6:13-14 Jas.1:9; ἐν (τ.) θεῷ, Rom.2:17 5:11; ἐν κυρίῳ, 1Co.1:31 (LXX)…
renderings: Then we will not be boasting

G2746.definition: (καυχάομαι),  ; a boasting, glorying: Rom.3:27, 2Co.11:10 11:17, Jas.4:16; before ὑπέρ, 2Co.7:4 8:24; ἐτί, with genitive, 2Co.7:14; ἔχω τὴν κ. ἐν Χρ. Ἰησ., Rom.15:17; στέφανος καυχήσεως (Ez. l.with, al.), 1Th.2:19; of the cause of glorying, a boast ( = καύχημα), 2Co.1:12.†; (AS)

G2745.definition: (καυχάομαι),  ; 1. a boast (Pind.): 2Co.5:12 9:3 (Thayer, see word; e. contra, 2, Ellic., Lft., on Gal.6:4; Lft., Notes, 204, 277). ; 2. ground or matter of glorying: Rom.4:2, 1Co.5:6 9:15-16, 2Co.1:14, Gal.6:4, Php.1:26 2:16, Heb.3:6 (cf. καύχησις).†; (AS)

G2758.definition: (κενός, which see),  ; to empty. Metaphorical, to empty, make empty, vain or of no effect: καύχημα, 1Co.9:15; ἑαυτόν, of Christ, Php.2:7 (v Lft.; ICC, in 1, and esp. Gifford, Incarn., 54 ff.); pass., πίστις, Rom.4:14; ὁ σταυρός, 1Co.1:17; καύχημα, 2Co.9:3†; (AS)

G2710.definition: κατα-χράομαι, -ῶμαι; to make full use of, use to the uttermost, use up: 1Co.7:31; with dative, 1Co.9:18 (for other senses, see LS, see word)..†; (AS)

G2789.definition: to play upon the lyre or harp: 1Co.14:7, Rev.14:2.†; (AS)

G2734.definition: (κάτοπτρον, a mirror), ; to show as in a mirror. Mid., to see oneself mirrored (see MM, Exp., xv); with accusative of thing(s) (R, txt., but see mg.), to reflect as a mirror: 2Co.3:18 (cf. Abbott, Essays, 94).†; (AS)

G2714.definition: adv. (= Hom., κατένωπα),  ; over against, before: with genitive, τ. δόξης, Ju 24; metaphorically (cf. κατέναντι, and see Lft., Col., l.with), τ. θεοῦ, Eph.1:4, Col.1:22.†; (AS)

G2732.definition: κατ-οικητήριον, -ου, τό; (κατοικέω),  ; a habitation, dwelling-place: Eph.2:22, Rev.18:2.†; (AS)

G2737.definition: (κάτω),  ; lower; τὰ. κ. τῆς γῆς (see AR, Eph., l.with; for rendering this lower earth, see ICC, Eph, l.with), the lower parts of the earth (cf. Psa.139:15; cf. also MGr., ἡ κάτου γῆ, the underworld, Thumb, MGV, 334): Eph.4:9.†; (AS)

G2754.definition: (κενόδοξος),  ; 1. foolish fancy, vain opinion, error (LXX, ll. with). ; 2. vain­glory, groundless conceit: Php.2:3.†; (AS)

G2709.definition: κατα-χθόνιος, -ον; (χθών, the earth), ; subterranean, under the earth (in cl., of the infernal gods): of the departed in Hades, opposite to ἐπουράνιος, ἐπίγειος, Php.2:10.†; (AS)

G2752.definition: (κελεύω),  ; a call, summons, shout of command: 1Th.4:16 (see M, Th., in l).†; (AS)

G2743.definition: καυστηριάζω (Rec. καυτηρ-, and so usually in Gk. writers, see Soph., Lex., see word) ; to mark by branding, brand (AV, scar, but see CGT, in l): metaphorically, pass. pf. ptcp., 1Ti.4:2 (cf. καυτήριον, 4Ma.15:22 *).†; (AS)

G2704.definition: κατα-φθείρω; 1 1 to destroy entirely. ; 2. In moral sense (as LXX), to deprave, corrupt: pass. pf. ptcp., before τ. νο ν, 2Ti.3:8.†; (AS)

G2777.definition: (dimin. of κεφαλή),  ; 1. a little head. ; 2. an extremity, capital (of a column). ; 3. (As in Exo.2:9, Psa.40:8, Est.6:2) a roll: κ. βιβλίου, Heb.10:7 (LXX).†; (AS)

G2761.definition: adv.,  ; in vain, to no purpose: Jas.4:5.†; (AS)

G2728.definition: κατ-ιόω, -ῶ; (intensive of ἰόω; ἰός)  ; to rust over; pass., become rusted over: Jas.5:3.†; (AS)

G2741.definition: (καῦσος, burning heat, fever), ; only in pass., ; 1. to burn with fever (Galen., al.). ; 2. In NT, to burn with great heat: 2Pe.3:10 3:12 (V. Mayor, in l).†; (AS)

G2764.definition: (κέραμος),  ; 1. (cl.) of a potter (e.g. γῆ). ; 2. In LXX and NT, = cl., κεραμεοῦς (Plut., κεράμειος, Polyb., -μαῖος, etc), earthen: Rev.2:27.†; (AS)

G2790.definition: κιθαρ-ωδός, -οῦ, ὁ; (κιθάρα, ἀοιδός, a singer) ; one who plays and sings to the lyre, a harper: Rev.14:2 18:22.†; (AS)

G2767.definition: to mix, mingle, chiefly of the diluting of wine: Rev.18:6; by oxymoron, κεκεράσμενος ἄκρατος, Rev.14:10.†; SYN.: μίγνυμι. κ. implies "a mixing of two things, so that they are blended and forma compound, as in wine and water, whereas μ. implies a mixing without such composition, as in two sorts of grain" (LS, see word κρᾶσις) (AS)

G2792.definition: κιννάμωμον(Rec. κινάμ-), -υο, τό ; (from the Phænician, see LS, see word, and cf. Heb. קִנָּמוֹן) ; cinnamon: Rev.18:13.†; (AS)
